FUNCTION TRINT_APPEND_TO_COMM_ARRAYS
  IMPORTING
    VALUE(WI_ERROR_TABLE) LIKE TRPARI-W_CHCK_ERR DEFAULT ' '
    VALUE(WI_SIMULATION) LIKE TRPARI-W_SIMULAT DEFAULT ' '
    VALUE(WI_SUPPRESS_KEY_CHECK) LIKE TRPARI-W_NO_CHECK DEFAULT ' '
    VALUE(WI_TRKORR) LIKE E070-TRKORR
    VALUE(WI_TRPAR_INT_FILLED) LIKE TRPARI-W_CHCK_FUL DEFAULT ' '
    VALUE(WI_LOCKKEY_FILLED) LIKE TRPARI-S_CHECKED DEFAULT ' '
    VALUE(IV_APPEND_AT_ORDER) LIKE TRPARI-S_CHECKED DEFAULT ' '
    VALUE(IV_APPEND_AT_ORDER_WITH_LOCK) LIKE TRPARI-S_CHECKED DEFAULT ' '
    VALUE(IV_NO_OWNER_CHECK) TYPE C DEFAULT ' '
    VALUE(IT_E071K_STR) TYPE E071K_STRTYP OPTIONAL
    VALUE(IV_DIALOG) TYPE TRBOOLEAN DEFAULT 'X'
  TABLES
    WT_E071 LIKE E071
    WT_E071K LIKE E071K OPTIONAL
    WT_TRMESS_INT LIKE TRMESS_INT OPTIONAL
    WT_TRPAR_INT LIKE TRPAR_INT OPTIONAL
    WT_LOCKKEY LIKE TLOCK_INT OPTIONAL
  EXCEPTIONS
    KEY_CHECK_KEYSYNTAX_ERROR
    OB_CHECK_OBJ_ERROR
    TR_LOCKMOD_FAILED
    TR_LOCK_ENQUEUE_FAILED
    TR_WRONG_ORDER_TYPE
    TR_ORDER_UPDATE_ERROR
    FILE_ACCESS_ERROR
    OB_NO_SYSTEMNAME.




  DATA: lv_edit                     TYPE c,
        lv_shared                   TYPE c,
        lv_object_not_lockable      LIKE trpari-s_locktype,
        lv_locktype                 LIKE trpari-s_locktype,
        lv_rcode                    LIKE sy-subrc,
        lv_tabix                    LIKE sy-tabix,
        lv_lines_e071               LIKE sy-tabix,
        lv_lines_trpar              LIKE sy-tabix,
        lv_lines_lockkey            LIKE sy-tabix,
        lv_uname                    LIKE sy-uname,
        lv_rest_length              LIKE tlock-len,
        lv_length_firstpart         LIKE tlock-len,
        lv_hikey_pattern            LIKE tlock-hikey,
        lv_tt_trpar_append          LIKE trpari-s_checked,
        lv_check_lockability        TYPE trboolean,
        lv_tabname                  LIKE dd02l-tabname,
        lv_tabkey                   LIKE e071k-tabkey,
        lv_obj_name                 LIKE e071-obj_name,
        lv_has_key                  TYPE c,
        lv_call_version_management  TYPE c,
        lv_hikeylen                 LIKE tlock-len,
        lv_update_done              TYPE c,
        lv_enqueue_done             TYPE c,
        lv_object_error             TYPE c,
        lv_cico_error               TYPE c,
        ls_e070                     LIKE e070,
        ls_e071                     LIKE e071,
        ls_e070c                    LIKE e070c,
        ls_request_header           TYPE trwbo_request_header,
        ls_e070m                    LIKE e070m,
        ls_tadir                    LIKE tadir,
        ls_tlock                    LIKE tlock,
        ls_lockkey                  LIKE tlock_int,
        lt_enqueue                  LIKE rse_tlock   OCCURS 0,
        ls_enqueue                  LIKE rse_tlock.

  DATA: lt_e071                     TYPE TABLE OF e071.

  DATA: BEGIN OF lt_delete OCCURS 10,
           index LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: END OF lt_delete.
* objects, allready contained and locked in the request.
* will be removed from wt_071, wt_trpar_int and lt_info
* after the object loop over wt_e071

  DATA: BEGIN OF ls_info,
           pgmid               LIKE e071-pgmid,
           object              LIKE e071-object,
           objname             LIKE e071-obj_name,
           langtyp             LIKE trpari-langtyp,
           langtypa            LIKE trpari-langtypa,
           not_lockable(1)     TYPE c,
           share(1)            TYPE c,
           lockflag            LIKE e071-lockflag,
           srcsystem           LIKE tadir-srcsystem,
           author              LIKE tadir-author,
           locktype            LIKE trpari-s_locktype,
        END OF ls_info.
  DATA : lt_info   LIKE ls_info  OCCURS 0.
* lt_info contains the objects, which will be marked repaired
* after the object loop over wt_e071

  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_remainder> TYPE c,
                 <lv_firstpart> TYPE c.

  DESCRIBE FIELD tlock-hikey LENGTH lv_hikeylen  IN CHARACTER MODE.

*---read system parameters---------------------------------------------*
  IF   system_name    =    space.
    CALL FUNCTION 'TR_SYS_PARAMS'
      IMPORTING
        systemname    = system_name
        systemtype    = system_type
        systemedit    = system_edit
      EXCEPTIONS
        no_systemname = 1
        no_systemtype = 2.
    CASE sy-subrc.
      WHEN 1. current_message_raising ob_no_systemname.
      WHEN 2. current_message_raising ob_no_systemname.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDIF.

*-- global checks on E070 ---------------------------------------------*
  REFRESH: wt_trmess_int.
  IF wi_trkorr = space.
    MESSAGE e136(tk) RAISING tr_wrong_order_type.
  ENDIF.
  SELECT SINGLE * FROM e070 INTO ls_e070  WHERE trkorr = wi_trkorr.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    MESSAGE e806(tr) WITH wi_trkorr RAISING tr_wrong_order_type.
  ENDIF.
  SELECT SINGLE * FROM e070c INTO ls_e070c WHERE trkorr = wi_trkorr.

  IF ls_e070-trfunction = tmvo OR ls_e070-trfunction = tmvd.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM e070m INTO ls_e070m
                               WHERE trkorr = wi_trkorr.
  ENDIF.

*** build internal parameters ******************************************
  IF ls_e070-trfunction CA tasktype.
    lv_edit = 'X'.
  ELSE.
    lv_edit = ' '.
  ENDIF.

*---request/task must not be released----------------------------------*
  IF ls_e070-trstatus CA relset.
    MESSAGE e126(tk) WITH wi_trkorr RAISING tr_wrong_order_type.
  ENDIF.

*---only append to request if users wants to---------------------------*
  IF  ls_e070-trfunction  NA   korrtype
  AND iv_append_at_order  =    space.
    MESSAGE e127(tk) WITH wi_trkorr RAISING tr_wrong_order_type.
  ENDIF.
  IF  ls_e070-trfunction NA alltype
  OR  ls_e070-trfunction =  tuco.
    MESSAGE e127(tk) WITH wi_trkorr RAISING tr_wrong_order_type.
  ENDIF.

*---request can only be changed by owner (except project piecelist)----*
*---or when owner_check is off
  IF  ls_e070-trfunction <> tproj
  AND ls_e070-as4user    <> sy-uname
  AND iv_no_owner_check  =  space.
    MESSAGE e771(tr) WITH wi_trkorr ls_e070-as4user
                     RAISING tr_wrong_order_type.
  ENDIF.

*---check correct client-----------------------------------------------*
  IF  ls_e070c-client <> space
  AND ls_e070c-client <> sy-mandt.
   MESSAGE e056(tk) WITH ls_e070-trkorr ls_e070c-client ls_e070-as4user
                          RAISING tr_wrong_order_type.
  ENDIF.

*** check if typecheck-results have been transfered by parameters ******
  IF wi_trpar_int_filled = 'X'
  OR wi_lockkey_filled   = 'X'.
    DESCRIBE TABLE wt_e071 LINES lv_lines_e071.
  ENDIF.

  IF wi_trpar_int_filled = 'X'.
    DESCRIBE TABLE wt_trpar_int LINES lv_lines_trpar.
    IF lv_lines_e071 >< lv_lines_trpar.
      CLEAR: wi_trpar_int_filled, wt_trpar_int[].
      lv_tt_trpar_append = 'X'.
    ELSE.
      lv_tt_trpar_append = ' '.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    lv_tt_trpar_append   = 'X'.
    CLEAR wt_trpar_int[].
  ENDIF.

  IF wi_lockkey_filled = 'X'.
    DESCRIBE TABLE wt_lockkey LINES lv_lines_lockkey.
    IF lv_lines_e071 <> lv_lines_lockkey.
      CLEAR: wi_lockkey_filled, wt_lockkey[].
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    CLEAR: wi_lockkey_filled, wt_lockkey[].
  ENDIF.

************************************************************************
*** check the E071-entries and built the lock for the E071-entry  ******
  LOOP AT wt_e071.

    lv_tabix = sy-tabix.
    CLEAR: lv_shared, wt_trmess_int, lv_locktype, ls_lockkey,
           lv_object_not_lockable, ls_tadir, ls_tlock, wt_e071-lockflag,
           lt_e071.

*** read typecheck results *********************************************
    IF wi_trpar_int_filled >< space.
      READ TABLE wt_trpar_int INDEX lv_tabix.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        PERFORM dequeue_all USING lv_enqueue_done lt_enqueue[].
        IF lv_update_done = 'X'.
          ROLLBACK WORK.
        ENDIF.
        MESSAGE e177(tk) WITH ls_e070-trkorr
                RAISING ob_check_obj_error.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
    IF wi_lockkey_filled >< space.
      READ TABLE wt_lockkey INDEX lv_tabix.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        PERFORM dequeue_all USING lv_enqueue_done lt_enqueue[].
        IF lv_update_done = 'X'.
          ROLLBACK WORK.
        ENDIF.
        MESSAGE e177(tk) WITH ls_e070-trkorr
                RAISING ob_check_obj_error.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

*** move orderkey E071 to E071k when TABU ******************************
    IF      wt_e071-object = 'TABU'
    AND (   wt_e071-pgmid  = 'R3TR'
         OR wt_e071-pgmid  = 'LANG' ).
      CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_SPLIT_TABU'
        EXPORTING
          iv_obj_name = wt_e071-obj_name
        IMPORTING
          ev_tabname  = lv_tabname
          ev_tabkey   = lv_tabkey
          ev_has_key  = lv_has_key
          ev_obj_name = lv_obj_name.
      IF   lv_has_key  =  'X'.
        CLEAR wt_e071k.
        wt_e071k-pgmid      = wt_e071-pgmid.
        wt_e071k-object     = wt_e071-object.
        wt_e071k-objname    = lv_tabname.
        wt_e071k-tabkey     = lv_tabkey.
        wt_e071k-mastertype = wt_e071-object.
        wt_e071k-mastername = lv_tabname.
        APPEND wt_e071k.

        wt_e071-obj_name    = lv_obj_name.
        wt_e071-objfunc     = 'K'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

*** if no locks, then only editor check ********************************
    IF ls_e070-trfunction CA tasktype
    OR (    iv_append_at_order           <> space
        AND iv_append_at_order_with_lock <> space ).
      lv_check_lockability = 'X'.
    ELSE.
      lv_check_lockability = ' '.
    ENDIF.

*** Object syntax/consistence/lockability-check ************************
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_e070m TO ls_request_header.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_e070c TO ls_request_header.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_e070  TO ls_request_header.
    ls_request_header-e070m_filled   = 'X'.
    ls_request_header-clients_filled = 'X'.
    ls_lockkey = wt_lockkey.
    CALL FUNCTION 'TR_REQ_CHECK_OBJECT'
      EXPORTING
        is_object              = wt_e071
        is_request_header      = ls_request_header
        iv_check_lockability   = lv_check_lockability
        iv_dialog              = iv_dialog
        iv_release_checks      = ' '
      IMPORTING
        es_object              = wt_e071
        ev_locktype            = lv_locktype
        es_tadir               = ls_tadir
        es_tlock               = ls_tlock
        ev_object_not_lockable = lv_object_not_lockable
      CHANGING
        cs_trpar_int           = wt_trpar_int
        cs_lockkey             = ls_lockkey
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                 = 1.

    lv_rcode = sy-subrc.

    IF lv_tt_trpar_append <> space.
      APPEND wt_trpar_int.
    ENDIF.

*** resolve returns ****************************************************
    IF lv_rcode <> 0.
      IF wi_error_table = 'X'.
        lv_object_error = 'X'.
        wt_trmess_int-tabix = lv_tabix.
        wt_trmess_int-msgid = sy-msgid.
        wt_trmess_int-msgty = sy-msgty.
        wt_trmess_int-msgno = sy-msgno.
        wt_trmess_int-msgv1 = sy-msgv1.
        wt_trmess_int-msgv2 = sy-msgv2.
        wt_trmess_int-msgv3 = sy-msgv3.
        wt_trmess_int-msgv4 = sy-msgv4.
        APPEND wt_trmess_int.
        CONTINUE.
      ELSE.
        PERFORM dequeue_all USING lv_enqueue_done lt_enqueue[].
        IF lv_update_done = 'X'.
          ROLLBACK WORK.
        ENDIF.
        current_message_raising ob_check_obj_error.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

*** system-E071-entries CORR .... not appendable ***********************
    IF wt_e071-pgmid = 'CORR'.
      IF wi_error_table = 'X'.
        lv_object_error = 'X'.
        wt_trmess_int-tabix = lv_tabix.
        wt_trmess_int-msgid = 'TK'.
        wt_trmess_int-msgty = 'E'.
        wt_trmess_int-msgno = '076'.
        wt_trmess_int-msgv1 = space.
        wt_trmess_int-msgv2 = space.
        wt_trmess_int-msgv3 = space.
        wt_trmess_int-msgv4 = space.
        APPEND wt_trmess_int.
        CONTINUE.
      ELSE.
        PERFORM dequeue_all USING lv_enqueue_done lt_enqueue[].
        IF lv_update_done = 'X'.
          ROLLBACK WORK.
        ENDIF.
        MESSAGE e076(tk) WITH wt_e071-pgmid wt_e071-object
                              wt_e071-obj_name
                RAISING ob_check_obj_error.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.


*** begin of database update ****1.part TLOCK-update *******************
    IF wi_simulation <> 'X'
    AND lv_object_error = space.
      IF  lv_object_not_lockable <> 'X'
      AND lv_locktype            NA 'LX'
      AND ( ls_e070-trfunction   CA tasktype
           OR (     iv_append_at_order           <> space
               AND  iv_append_at_order_with_lock <> space
               AND  ls_e070-trfunction           CA transport_type ) ).

*** enqueue to avoid synchron select and update on TLOCK ***************
        CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_E_TLOCK'
          EXPORTING
            object       = ls_tadir-object
            obj_name     = ls_tadir-obj_name
            pgmid        = ls_tadir-pgmid
          EXCEPTIONS
            foreign_lock = 01.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_uname = sy-msgv1.
          PERFORM dequeue_all USING lv_enqueue_done lt_enqueue[].
          IF lv_update_done = 'X'. ROLLBACK WORK. ENDIF.
          MESSAGE e106(tk) WITH ls_tadir-obj_name lv_uname
                                ls_tadir-pgmid ls_tadir-object
                           RAISING tr_lock_enqueue_failed.
        ELSE.
          lv_enqueue_done     = 'X'.
          ls_enqueue-pgmid    = ls_tadir-pgmid.
          ls_enqueue-object   = ls_tadir-object.
          ls_enqueue-obj_name = ls_tadir-obj_name.
          APPEND ls_enqueue TO lt_enqueue.
        ENDIF.

************************************************************************
***call version management when appending to tasks and K-Requests*******
***when locktype is
***                space  : not locked
***                    R  : correct order/task, but wrong size
***                    P  : shared locks, different tasks same order
************************************************************************
        IF lv_locktype CA ' RP'
        AND (   ls_e070-trfunction CA tasktype
             OR ls_e070-trfunction = trco ).
          ls_e071 = wt_e071.
          APPEND ls_e071 TO lt_e071.
          CALL FUNCTION 'SVRS_BEFORE_CHANGED'
            TABLES
              e071_tab = lt_e071
            EXCEPTIONS
              OTHERS   = 0.
        ENDIF.

*** insert/update lock-entry if object is lockable *********************
*** create pattern for TLOCK-LIKE-deletion *  **************************
        IF lv_locktype NA ' XL'.
          lv_hikey_pattern = ls_lockkey-hi.
          IF ls_lockkey-pat_len > 0.
            ASSIGN lv_hikey_pattern(ls_lockkey-pat_len)
                                    TO <lv_firstpart>.
*           work around LIKE OR LIKE
            lv_length_firstpart = STRLEN( <lv_firstpart> ).
            IF lv_length_firstpart > ls_lockkey-pat_len.
              lv_length_firstpart = ls_lockkey-pat_len.
            ENDIF.
            lv_rest_length = lv_hikeylen - lv_length_firstpart.
            IF lv_rest_length > 0.
            ASSIGN lv_hikey_pattern+lv_length_firstpart(lv_rest_length)
                     TO <lv_remainder>.
              <lv_remainder> = '%'.
            ENDIF.
          ELSE.
            lv_hikey_pattern = '%'.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        CASE lv_locktype.
*** no append, if order already locked by owner right size *************
          WHEN 'L'.

*** object is not locked  **********************************************
          WHEN space.
            wt_e071-lockflag = 'X'.
            ls_tlock-object      = ls_lockkey-obj.
            ls_tlock-hikey       = ls_lockkey-hi.
            ls_tlock-lokey       = ls_lockkey-low.
            ls_tlock-len         = ls_lockkey-len.
            ls_tlock-trkorr      = ls_e070-trkorr.
            ls_tlock-author      = sy-uname.
            ls_tlock-edtflag     = lv_edit.
            INSERT tlock FROM ls_tlock.

            IF sy-subrc <> 0.
              PERFORM dequeue_all USING lv_enqueue_done lt_enqueue.
              IF lv_update_done = 'X'.
                ROLLBACK WORK.
              ENDIF.
              MESSAGE e125(tk) WITH ls_tlock-object
                                    ls_tlock-hikey(50)
                               RAISING tr_lockmod_failed.
            ENDIF.
            lv_update_done = 'X'.

*** object is locked for this order in different size ******************
          WHEN 'R'.
            wt_e071-lockflag = 'X'.
*           leave if any order-lock is already bigger
            IF ls_tlock-hikey <= ls_lockkey-hi.
*             delete smaller locks and set bigger one
              DELETE FROM tlock
                     WHERE object =    ls_lockkey-obj
                     AND   hikey  >=   ls_lockkey-low
                     AND   hikey  LIKE lv_hikey_pattern
                     AND   lokey  <=   ls_lockkey-hi.
              IF sy-subrc <> 0.

                  ROLLBACK WORK.
                ENDIF.
                MESSAGE e125(tk) WITH ls_tlock-object

              lv_update_done = 'X'.
              ls_tlock-object      = ls_lockkey-obj.
              ls_tlock-hikey       = ls_lockkey-hi.
              ls_tlock-lokey       = ls_lockkey-low.
              ls_tlock-len         = ls_lockkey-len.
              ls_tlock-trkorr      = ls_e070-trkorr.
              ls_tlock-author      = sy-uname.

              IF sy-subrc <> 0.
                PERFORM dequeue_all USING lv_enqueue_done lt_enqueue.

                  ROLLBACK WORK.
                ENDIF.
                MESSAGE e125(tk) WITH ls_tlock-object
                                      ls_tlock-hikey(50)
                                 RAISING tr_lockmod_failed.
              ENDIF.
            ELSE.
              lv_locktype = k_l.
            ENDIF.

*** object locks are shared in request *********************************
          WHEN 'P'.
            lv_shared        = 'X'.
            wt_e071-lockflag = 'X'.
*           if request locks are smaller, delete them and set bigger one
            IF ls_tlock-hikey <= ls_lockkey-hi.
              DELETE FROM tlock
                     WHERE object =    ls_lockkey-obj
                     AND   hikey  >=   ls_lockkey-low
                     AND   hikey  LIKE lv_hikey_pattern
                     AND   lokey  <=   ls_lockkey-hi.
              IF sy-subrc <> 0.
                PERFORM dequeue_all USING lv_enqueue_done lt_enqueue.
                IF lv_update_done = 'X'.
                  ROLLBACK WORK.
                ENDIF.
                MESSAGE e125(tk) WITH ls_tlock-object
                                      ls_tlock-hikey(50)
                                 RAISING tr_lockmod_failed.
              ENDIF.
              lv_update_done = 'X'.
              ls_tlock-object      = ls_lockkey-obj.
              ls_tlock-hikey       = ls_lockkey-hi.
              ls_tlock-lokey       = ls_lockkey-low.
              ls_tlock-len         = ls_lockkey-len.
              ls_tlock-trkorr      = ls_e070-trkorr.
              ls_tlock-author      = sy-uname.
              ls_tlock-edtflag     = lv_edit.
              INSERT tlock FROM ls_tlock.
              IF sy-subrc <> 0.
                PERFORM dequeue_all USING lv_enqueue_done lt_enqueue.
                IF lv_update_done = 'X'.
                  ROLLBACK WORK.
                ENDIF.
                MESSAGE e125(tk) WITH ls_tlock-object
                                      ls_tlock-hikey(50)
                                 RAISING tr_lockmod_failed.

*** if projects locks are bigger, switch lock to this order ************
            ELSE.

                  EXPORTING

                  IMPORTING

                    we_obj_name    = wt_e071-obj_name
                    we_pgmid       = wt_e071-pgmid

                IF sy-subrc <> 0.

                  IF lv_update_done = 'X'.

                ENDIF.
              ENDIF.
              ls_tlock-trkorr  = ls_e070-trkorr.
              ls_tlock-author  = sy-uname.
              ls_tlock-edtflag = lv_edit.
              UPDATE tlock FROM ls_tlock.
              IF sy-subrc <> 0.
                PERFORM dequeue_all USING lv_enqueue_done lt_enqueue.
                IF lv_update_done = 'X'.
                  ROLLBACK WORK.

                MESSAGE e125(tk) WITH ls_tlock-object
                                      ls_tlock-hikey(50)
                                 RAISING tr_lockmod_failed.
              ENDIF.
              lv_update_done = 'X'.
            ENDIF.

***set flag for co-maintenance when Object is maintained outside this
***this system also
        PERFORM set_cico_comnt USING ls_lockkey
                            CHANGING lv_cico_error.

        IF lv_cico_error = space.
          lv_update_done = 'X'.
        ELSE.

          MESSAGE e048(tk) WITH ls_tadir-pgmid

                                ls_tadir-obj_name
                                ls_tlock-hikey(50)

*** no append, if order already locked by owner right size *************
*** except new ddic delete concept tabl/sqlt ***************************

                                ls_e070
                                ls_e070c
                                lv_enqueue_done
                                lt_enqueue[]
                                lv_update_done
                       CHANGING wt_e071k[].

* string.

                                   ls_e070c
                                   lv_enqueue_done
                                   lt_enqueue[]
                                   lv_update_done

  ENDIF.


*** next database update ****2.part E071/E071K/E070/SAPNAMES/Versions **
  IF wi_simulation <> 'X'.
*** delete already locked and inserted E071 entries ********************
    SORT lt_delete DESCENDING BY index.
    LOOP AT lt_delete.

      DELETE lt_info      INDEX lt_delete-index.

*** append entry to task ***********************************************
    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_APPEND_COMM'

        wi_sel_e071  = 'X'
        wi_sel_e071k = 'X'

    IF   sy-subrc  ><   0.
      PERFORM dequeue_all USING lv_enqueue_done lt_enqueue[].
      ROLLBACK WORK.
      current_message_raising tr_order_update_error.
    ENDIF.

    ls_e070-as4date = sy-datum.

    UPDATE e070 FROM ls_e070.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.

      ROLLBACK WORK.
      MESSAGE e040(tk) WITH ls_e070-trkorr
                       RAISING tr_order_update_error.
    ENDIF.

*** possibly send repair notice to responsible TADIR-author  *******
    SORT lt_info BY pgmid object objname.

    IF ls_e070-trfunction CA tasktype.
      LOOP AT wt_e071.
        READ TABLE lt_info INTO ls_info
                           WITH KEY pgmid    =  wt_e071-pgmid
                                    object   =  wt_e071-object
                                    objname  =  wt_e071-obj_name
                           BINARY SEARCH.

        CHECK sy-subrc = 0.

        IF  ls_info-not_lockable <> 'X'
        AND ls_info-locktype     <> k_l
        AND ls_info-srcsystem    <> system_name
        AND (   ls_info-langtyp  <> 'L'
             OR ls_info-langtypa NA 'EL' ).

          IF   sy-uname       <> ls_info-author
          AND  ls_info-author <> 'SAP'
          AND  ls_info-author <> space.
            CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_INDICATE_REPAIR'
              EXPORTING
                iv_trkorr        = ls_e070-trkorr
                iv_sapnames_user = ls_info-author
                iv_date          = sy-datum
                iv_time          = sy-uzeit
                iv_repair_user   = sy-uname
              EXCEPTIONS
                OTHERS           = 1.
            IF sy-subrc = 1.
              current_message_raising file_access_error.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      ENDLOOP.

    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  PERFORM dequeue_all USING lv_enqueue_done lt_enqueue[].
ENDFUNCTION.

source: ******* Properties of the string in E071K-TABKEY
*       Length of key specification with generic '*'
*       Length of key specification without generic '*'
*       Use and position of generic symbol
*       Length of concatenated char key fields up to first nonchar field
* used in CHECK_CUSTOMER_NAMES to protect customer entries in
*   Interner Fehler beim Aufruf einer Schnittstelle des CTS
*   Bezugsfelder eines Objektschlüssels nicht gefüllt (intern. Synta...)
*   Bei Transport von Tabelleninhalten muß Schlüssel gefüllt sein
*   Schlüsseleintrag ist mit angegebener Funktion nicht möglich
* Check if table belongs to TDAT/VDAT/CDAT
* Get key length by finding the beginning of the trailing spaces
IF is_key-tabkey CP '*#*# '.   "pos. of last * followed by spaces only
*   Client part in tabkey-string has to be a) = source client of request
*       Stuff is client dependent, but transport of client dependent
*   Determine total length of char-like key-fields. + 1 for final '*'
*   raw data type'X'.( zwei zeichen = 1 byte). arrowed ?  dann soll.
*       Get the value of the key field
*         Error: special sign in the field with the generic key
*       Check compatibility between value and field type
*             Key field of a full qualified key has wrong data type
*               Key field, of a generic key, has wrong data type
*           Error: specified language is not allowed (not in table T002)
*       Point to asterisks that are not interpreted as generic sign
*           Nur der Stern am Ende bewirkt Generik
*   Für Tabelle &1 sind keine Schlüsselfelder definiert
*   Tabellenschlüssel der Tabelle &1 nur bis zur &2. Stelle füllen
* cut off unallowed key part (if any) for further checks
* non-character-keyfields but no generic key entry
AND is_key-tabkey NP '*#*'.      "-> find the trailing pattern '* '
*       Das Generiksymbol "*" wurde in den Schlüssel eingefügt
*     Geben Sie den Schlüssel generisch ein
* table key longer than E071k-tabkey, but no generic key entry
AND is_key-tabkey        NP '*#*'. "-> find the trailing pattern '* '
*   Tabellenschlüssel zur Tabelle &1 nur generisch zulässig
* In SAP systems, check reserved names, except for piece lists
*   Check if key of tables of classes E and G are in customer range
OR sv_delivery_class = 'G'.        "why only E and G?
*         key is generic and covers SAP and customer entries
*         > warning, because R3trans will transport only the SAP part
